source.title: A computational model of action selection in the basal ganglia. I. A new functional anatomy.

confidence_rationale: This is the canonical formalisation of the exact dichotomy Q-078 raises: that action selection is a dedicated architectural FUNCTION (a distinct 'selection' pathway implementing feedforward off-centre on-surround competition, regulated by a separate 'control' pathway) rather than an emergent property of upstream signal strength. Gurney/Prescott/Redgrave recast selection as SIGNAL selection over scalar saliences and show the biological BG is organised as a purpose-built selection circuit -- direct conceptual support for the CONSTITUTIONAL reading (a BG-like selection constitution is a real, dedicated thing beyond parametric salience). Confidence held below 0.8 because the paper does not test REE's specific F-variance-share-vs-constitution contrast; it establishes that the biological reference architecture Q-078 invokes genuinely exists and is functionally load-bearing, which is the load-bearing premise of the constitutional hypothesis but not a direct test of REE's E3 ceiling.
failure_signatures: If REE's E3 conversion ceiling is CONSTITUTIONAL, then no amount of parametric strengthening of upstream saliences will reliably convert committed action -- exactly the pattern Q-078 reports across CRF/OFC/SD-037/dACC/modulatory channels. Gurney 2001 predicts this: in their model, raising a channel's salience without the selection+control architecture in place does not yield clean selection; the off-centre on-surround competition and the control pathway's regulation are what make a strong signal WIN rather than merely be present.

An REE substrate that routes salience directly to action authority without a dedicated selection layer (feedforward inhibitory competition + a separate control/regulation pathway) should exhibit either no selection or distortion-of-selection under strong input -- the signature of a missing selection constitution rather than a weak signal.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The basal ganglia are organised around a single primary computation -- action selection -- reframed as signal selection over scalar salience values. A biologically plausible feedforward off-centre on-surround network performs the selection per se (the 'selection pathway'), while a functionally distinct 'control pathway' regulates that selection to keep it effective, synergistically with dopaminergic modulation. This decomposition (selection vs control) is offered as superior to the prevailing direct/indirect-pathway segregation for explaining how one action is cleanly chosen among competitors.
mapping.ree_translation: Q-078 asks whether REE's failure to convert a formed, measurable upstream signal into committed action is CONSTITUTIONAL (the rules by which candidates become eligible to win -- eligibility mask, Go/No-Go, conflict-sensitive hold, threshold/widening, recurrent competition, commit-permission, post-commit latch -- are under-specified) rather than PARAMETRIC. Gurney 2001 is the reference model for the constitutional side: it demonstrates that biological selection is implemented as a DEDICATED architecture (a selection network plus a separate control/regulation network), not as a threshold on raw salience. This supports the reading that REE needs a BG-like selection CONSTITUTION beyond MECH-439's F-variance-share/shortlist parametric levers -- a formed signal reaching E3 authority is necessary but not sufficient; the off-centre on-surround competition and the control regulation are the missing lawful-access machinery.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is a computational-neuroscience model of motor/behavioural selection, not a test of REE's E3 pathway. It establishes that the constitutional architecture Q-078 hypothesises is biologically real and functionally necessary in the reference system, but it cannot by itself adjudicate whether REE's specific ceiling is constitutional vs parametric -- that requires the paired experiment Q-078's next_action calls for. The paper also predates and does not address the F-dominance framing; the mapping is architecture-level analogy, not a measured correspondence.
mapping.source_context: Computational model / theoretical neuroscience (Biological Cybernetics 2001). Abstracted rate-coded BG channel model; no behavioural or physiological data collected in this Part I (the functional-anatomy paper); companion Part II presents simulation results.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality high -- the foundational, heavily-cited formalisation of BG-as-selection and the selection/control decomposition. Mapping fidelity good: the paper's central claim (selection is a dedicated architecture, not a salience threshold) is precisely the constitutional pole of Q-078. Transfer risk moderate: analogy from a rate-coded motor-selection model to REE's E3 committed-action pathway is plausible but untested; the paper supports the plausibility of the constitutional hypothesis rather than confirming it for REE.
